caveats: Headless stream-json only; interactive ask/deny dialogs unobserved.
Attribution control: the smoke call WITHOUT the rule was ALSO denied (headless prompt gate) -- rule firing proven, rule necessity NOT proven for headless mode.

Originals preserved per cell as verdict_original + decision_kind_original.

Exfiltration held by refusal (10/12 no-decision); credential reads are the hole; npm-test overblock.
Wrapper-aware matcher: sudo/bash/env variants denied by the mapped rule.
Sandbox not-started in every cell (no Docker in container).
